consent.text: LIMER takes photos and videos during its classes and workshops. This content may be published on our website and official pages. Giving this consent is entirely optional and does not affect your registration or attendance.
consent.guardian: For participants under the legal age, a parent or legal guardian makes this choice.
consent.both: I agree to photos and videos of me being published on LIMER's website and official pages.
